dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Presence of a slight asymmetrical outward bulge on the mid-left margin; the right margin is comparatively more linear.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity median pixel values across the visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single high-contrast dark circular point on the anterior midline; multiple fine, low-contrast longitudinal linear marks on the posterior dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A sharp, straight longitudinal shadow-casting indentation along the posterior central dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint, parallel linear marks on the posterior dorsal plane, consistent with healed epidermal trauma.
